owner_evaluation.summary: The ledger is schema-valid but its single whole-sentence CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry does not exhaustively inventory candidate-carried real-world semantic targets.
owner_evaluation.minimum_missing_commitment: The money-hiding wording survives vehicle neutralization as financial concealment or nontransparency and is independently carried by the candidate.
owner_evaluation.secondary_required_adjudication: The hedged need for greater transparency may carry a story-local assessment of insufficient transparency and cannot be silently absorbed without an explicit return-or-editorial determination.
owner_evaluation.non_commitment_boundary: The employees-in-light component remains creative unless a distinct surviving proposition is demonstrated; the generated gloss of forced visibility is not itself evidence.
owner_evaluation.coverage_receipt_finding: COMPLETE and the affirmative embedded/factual-return receipts are not semantically supported by the emitted entries.

failure_analysis.evidence: The model correctly found an integrated creative construction but emitted that whole construction as one STANDALONE entry and stopped decomposition.
failure_analysis.impact: Integrated-host precedence became an endpoint rather than the start of an embedded-return audit.

failure_analysis.evidence: The creative commitment gloss explicitly names financial opacity, forced visibility, and a need for accounting clarity while emitting no REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT or UNRESOLVED_SCOPE entry.
failure_analysis.impact: Free-text semantic interpretation can acknowledge truth-evaluable targets without making them auditable ledger propositions.

failure_analysis.evidence: Schema and source-membership validators prove field coherence and exact spans, but the coverage booleans are model assertions and cannot prove that every surviving proposition was emitted.
failure_analysis.impact: A one-entry creative ledger can mechanically claim COMPLETE after semantic omission.

failure_analysis.evidence: The prompt requires vehicle neutralization but does not mechanically separate vehicle wording, editorial evaluation, and the story-local truth-evaluable target acknowledged in the creative gloss.
failure_analysis.impact: The model may treat the target interpretation as merely an explanation of the metaphor rather than a proposition requiring separate adjudication.

failure_analysis.evidence: Transport, constrained decoding, persistence, schema validation, and source membership all succeeded. The diagnostic adapter preserved the baseline allowed-token set exactly.
failure_analysis.impact: Projector performance or liveness changes would not remediate this semantic false negative.

bounded_remediation_design.name: STAGE_P_CREATIVE_TARGET_DECOMPOSITION_V1
bounded_remediation_design.principle: Finding an integrated creative host starts, rather than ends, a target-by-target factual-return audit.
requirements: For every CONTAINED_CREATIVE host, identify each story-local semantic target used to explain the transformation before declaring coverage complete.
For each target, apply the existing assertion, presupposition, entailment, and necessary-implication survival tests independently of the figurative vehicle.
Emit a separate overlapping REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT when a truth-evaluable target survives; cite exact governed support when available and preserve unsupported returns when not.
Keep evaluative stance, advice, normative judgment, and purely comic vehicle material distinct from factual propositions; do not force every metaphorical target into REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT.
If the target cannot be resolved confidently as factual return versus contained editorial evaluation, emit UNRESOLVED_SCOPE and INDETERMINATE rather than COMPLETE.
A CONTAINED_CREATIVE commitment description must not introduce a truth-evaluable real-world predicate that is absent from a separate return entry or an explicit unresolved entry.
Whole-sentence creative spans remain allowed, but COMPLETE requires target-decomposition evidence for each material predicate named in the creative gloss.
Preserve multiple valid segmentations; require proposition coverage, not prescribed spans, wording, entry counts, or a Case 01 label.
negative_controls: A purely fanciful vehicle whose target is only evaluative or comic remains representable as contained creative without a manufactured fact.
An unsupported factual target embedded in figurative wording remains representable and must be inventoried even without lexical markers.
A governed literal or implied target cites exact authority support rather than copying authority into a candidate-absent commitment.
An ambiguous mixed target yields UNRESOLVED_SCOPE and INDETERMINATE.
Entity reuse alone does not create a factual return.
verification_sequence_if_separately_auth: Design an evaluation-only prompt/contract candidate with explicit creative-target decomposition receipts or equivalent auditable structure.
Perform zero-inference schema, grammar, padding, identity, request-construction, and constrained-trie compatibility verification.
Use structural fixtures covering pure creative, governed embedded return, unsupported embedded return, normative evaluation, and unresolved mixed scope.
Only after separate approval, run one Case 01 probe with no retry, repair, selection, Stage C, or additional case.

recommended_next_step: Owner-review this frozen failure analysis, then authorize design-only construction of the Stage P Creative Target Decomposition V1 prompt/contract candidate before any implementation or inference.
